fix(compile): unwind the doc indent when a child generator throws (#6570) `Doc.indented` decremented after the callback returned, so a child that threw `ZodCompileUnsupportedError` left the level raised. `compileChild` catches that throw, rolls back the content and the counters, and emits a runtime island — but `Doc.indent` was never part of the rollback, so every line after an island was written

fix(docs): render the docs 404 page inside the (doc) layout once Under Turbopack the root not-found, which wraps itself in DocsLayout, is rendered inside the (doc) layout's DocsLayout as well, so every 404 under the docs catch-all showed two sidebars. A segment-level not-found without its own layout renders the shell once; the root one still serves routes outside the docs segment.
